newsitem.title: USA: Meridian Industrial Trust Q1 full results.
newsitem.headline: Meridian Industrial Trust Q1 full results.

text.p: Notes to Financial Statements (unaudited; dollars in thousands)

(1) The Company calculates funds from operations (FFO) in accordance with the white paper published by the National Association of Real Estate Investment Trusts, Inc. FFO means net income (loss), (computed in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles), excluding gains (or losses) from debt restructuring and sales of property, plus depreciation and amortization relating to real property and after adjustment from unconsolidated partnerships and joint ventures.
(2) Reflects the merger and commencement of real estate operations on February 23, 1996.
(3) Includes $402 and $78 for straight-line rents for the three month periods ended March 31, 1997 and 1996, respectively.

(4) The weighted average number of common shares outstanding was calculated as if the outstanding shares of Series B Convertible Preferred Stock had been converted into shares of Common Stock. (5) Excludes square footage for build-to-suit properties in progress.
